newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei up on news of buying Yaohan stores.
newsitem.headline: Daiei up on news of buying Yaohan stores.

text.p: Shares in Daiei Inc, a major supermarket chain operator, rose on Tuesday morning, helped by Monday"s news that it reached an agreement with Yaohan Japan Corp to buy 16 of Yaohan's outlets for 33 billion yen, trdaders said.
At 0040 GMT, Daiei's share price was up 7 yen at 812 yen, on volume of 185,000 shares. Yaohan"s shares were up 3 at 415 yen, after earlier trading as high as 420.
"We take the news as a positive factor for both Daiei and Yaohan," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
Yaohan said on Monday that the sale, part of a broad restructuring programme it announced earlier this month, would make possible the redemption of corporate bonds due in May.
Separately, Daiei said on Monday in a statement that the purchase would help strengthen its sales network in central Japan, where all 16 outlets are located.
